The behavior is flagged as suspicious due to deviation from normal network enumeration patterns.

biocs.name: Uncommon IP Configuration Listing
biocs.description: Detection of ipconfig.exe being executed with flags that list network configuration details outside of normal usage patterns
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\ipconfig.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains '/all' or action_process_command_line contains '/showclassid'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\cmd.exe'
